desc: This Pattern was posted by AmruthGowda91200. Tagged with: simple, blue, minimalist, html, css, pattern, bold, orange, blue, vibrant, diagonal, contrast, stripes, pattern.
css:
.container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      -45deg,
      #ff7e5f,
      #ff7e5f 10px,
      #3f51b5 10px,
      #3f51b5 20px
    ),
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      45deg,
      #3f51b5,
      #3f51b5 10px,
      #ff7e5f 10px,
      #ff7e5f 20px
    ),
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      -30deg,
      #3f51b5,
      #3f51b5 10px,
      #ff7e5f 10px,
      #ff7e5f 20px
    ),
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      30deg,
      #ff7e5f,
      #ff7e5f 10px,
      #3f51b5 10px,
      #3f51b5 20px
    );
}
